faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 made in China?
faqs.a: A Philips technical sheet identifies China as the country of production and Jiangsu Konsung as the manufacturer of Oxygenate 5, model KSW-5. Philips distributes it. Confirm the label and documents for the individual India-sold unit.

faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 a Konsung KSW-5?
faqs.a: A German medical-device listing identifies Oxygenate 5, product 1156380, as model KSW-5 made by Jiangsu Konsung. Philips distributes Oxygenate 5. Check the label and documentation of an individual unit, since configurations and warranty terms may differ by market.

faqs.q: How much does Oxygenate 5 cost in India?
faqs.a: Indicative India pricing is ₹45,000–₹55,000. Confirm taxes, availability, delivery, setup and accessories before ordering.

faqs.q: What warranty is advertised in India?
faqs.a: Philips India describes a three-year limited device warranty and a 10,000-hour sieve warranty. Ask for the applicable written conditions, exclusions and claim process.
